# v2026.10.53-3

<!-- Written by scripts/release/changelog.mjs from CHANGELOG/2026.10.53-3.md. Do not edit it: the release cut writes it again. -->

AI agents and tools can read these release notes as [plain Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arcforgelabs/flow/main/CHANGELOG/2026.10.53-3.md).

This release covers **6 pull requests, with thanks to 2 contributors.**

## Highlights

- A read field goes to the custom field of the same name; mark work system fields. ([#389](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/389)) Thanks [@cursoragent](https://github.com/cursoragent).
- Quieter Custom fields page (New button, no empty text or count). ([#409](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/409))
- Seazona discovery revisits earlier order dates without delaying new jobs. ([#455](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/455))
- An issued invoice shows why Xero refused it. ([#444](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/444)) Thanks [@RoboForgeBot](https://github.com/RoboForgeBot).
- Daily checks no longer report existing non-billable jobs as missing. ([#463](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/463))

## Changes

- A read field goes to the custom field of the same name; mark work system fields. ([#389](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/389)) Thanks [@cursoragent](https://github.com/cursoragent).
- Quieter Custom fields page (New button, no empty text or count). ([#409](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/409))

## Fixes

- Seazona discovery revisits earlier order dates without delaying new jobs. ([#455](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/455))
- An issued invoice shows why Xero refused it. ([#444](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/444)) Thanks [@RoboForgeBot](https://github.com/RoboForgeBot).
- Daily checks no longer report existing non-billable jobs as missing. ([#463](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/463))
